Instructions for applicants:
Good academic record as defined by the University with at least
55% marks(or an equivalent grading system is followed) at the
Master's Degree level in Mathematics/ Applied Mathematics
from recognized Indian University or an equivalent degree from
an accredited foreign University.
Besides fulfilling the above qualification, the candidate should
have either cleared the NET conducted by the UGC-CSIR or
similar test accredited by the university like SLET/SET.
Candidates, who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in
accordance with the UGC's Regulation 2009, shall be exempted
from the requirement of the minimum eligibility condition of
NET/SLET/SET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant
Professor or equivalent positions in
University/ College/Institutions.
Without prejudice to the above, the following conditions may
be considered desirable:
a) Teaching, research and Professional experience in a
reputed organization.
b) Papers presented at Conferences and/or in referred
journals.
The appointment of Guest Faculty is on lecture basis with token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture
subject to the ceiling of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that
he/she willnot draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency and willdo
the same till they are teaching in UIET as Guest Faculty.
1. The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at the website
https://forms.puchd.ac,in/forms/20200122155429
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf
2. The applicationsmust reach the office of the Director, UIET by 13.10.2025 upto 4.00 PM
3. The interview for the positions shall be held on 15.10.2025 at 11.30am in the office of the
Director. UIET. The eligible candidates shall be intimated by phone call.
4. All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification at the time of interview.
